units.source_text: 尽管我这方面是没有任何内疚的，却反而害怕被对方发现。

en.t: Although I had nothing to feel guilty about in that regard, I was instead afraid of being discovered by the other person.

units.source_text: 因为那一瞬间，我泛起了一股想逃避的心绪，

en.t: For in that instant, a desire to escape welled up inside me,

units.source_text: 不愿成为老师便装外游的目击者、见证人，

en.t: and I did not want to become a witness, an observer, of the teacher going out in ordinary clothes,

units.source_text: 不愿同老师在无言中结下信赖和不信赖的相互交织的关系。

en.t: nor did I want to enter, wordlessly, into a relationship with the teacher in which trust and distrust were intertwined.
